import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Extract month name
df['start_month'] = df['date'].dt.month_name()

# Clean acquisition_cost and convert to float
df['acquisition_cost'] = df['acquisition_cost'].replace({'\$': '', ',': ''}, regex=True).astype(float)

# Calculate average acquisition cost per month
monthly_avg_cost = df.groupby('start_month')['acquisition_cost'].mean().reset_index()

# Define month order
month_order = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December']
monthly_avg_cost['start_month'] = pd.Categorical(monthly_avg_cost['start_month'], categories=month_order, ordered=True)
monthly_avg_cost = monthly_avg_cost.sort_values('start_month')

# Create the plot
fig = px.bar(
    monthly_avg_cost,
    x='start_month',
    y='acquisition_cost',
    title='Gennemsnitlig Acquisition Cost per Kampagne efter Startmåned',
    labels={'acquisition_cost': 'Gennemsnitlig Acquisition Cost (USD)', 'start_month': 'Måned'},
    text='acquisition_cost',
    color='acquisition_cost',
    color_continuous_scale='Viridis'
)

fig.update_traces(texttemplate='$%{text:,.0f}', textposition='outside')
fig.update_layout(yaxis_title='Gennemsnitlig Acquisition Cost (USD)', xaxis_title='Måned', coloraxis_showscale=False)

fig.write_html(filepath)
